description: Eli Lilly is one of the world's largest pharmaceutical companies by market capitalization, transformed in the 2020s by the commercial success of its GLP-1/GIP receptor agonist tirzepatide (Mounjaro for diabetes, Zepbound for obesity). Its next-generation triple agonist retatrutide — targeting GLP-1, GIP, and glucagon receptors simultaneously — produced up to 28.7 percent average body weight loss in Phase 3 TRIUMPH trials and is on track for an NDA filing in late 2026 or early 2027, with potential approval in 2027-2028. Lilly also markets Verzenio (breast cancer), Jardiance (diabetes/heart failure), and Taltz (inflammatory disease).
